added_comments.text: Non-ISO shapes some partners send; ISO 8601 (with or without offset, fractional seconds, 'Z', basic or extended form) goes through datetime.fromisoformat instead.

rationale: The agent removed the buggy _clean() string mangling and the _KNOWN_FORMATS workaround entirely, replacing them with datetime.fromisoformat for ISO 8601 parsing, which fixes the root cause for the whole class of offset/precision inputs rather than special-casing the one reported format. The Globex end-of-day branch and its logic were left untouched and still fires before the generic parser, preserving the contractual behavior.
